sdc.daemon.CaseState.title: CaseState
sdc.daemon.CaseState.description: Where a case stands as the daemon reads its run's tree: Ended when it has an outcome; else AwaitingPerson or AwaitingAuthority when its last stop waits on that and the run waits on a decision; else Stuck when its last stop is Stuck or BudgetSpent and the run ended by its tree (Ended and not orphaned; a wait or a cancel that ended with the run, or an orphaned run, leaves it Open); else Running when the run's step in flight names the case; else Open. A type and not a lifecycle: no command moves a case, the daemon reads where it stands.
